spec.description: New example for steps 3c/3e of llm-dlc/loops/sound-verdicts.md: the recorded example of a proof that closes only through agent-written contracts. The same Crosscut change as example 147 (Jitter#fullJitterMillis), with the nextInt contract corrected to throw IllegalArgumentException when bound <= 0. Under --engine native --gaps advised --contracts gaps.contracts the contract for Integer.numberOfLeadingZeros is proved against the bytecode of java.lang.Integer from the JDK image, the two for java.util.Random are tested on a real JVM, and the property (result in [0, capMillis), IllegalArgumentException for an invalid policy) is proved on every input. The page should show both evidence levels.
